question.text: The energy required to break one mole of $\mathrm{Cl}-\mathrm{Cl}$ bonds in $\mathrm{Cl}_2$ is $242 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$. The longest wavelength of light capable of breaking a single $\mathrm{Cl}-\mathrm{Cl}$ bond is $\left(\mathrm{c}=3 \times 10^8 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}\right.$ and $\left.\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{A}}=6.02 \times 10^{23} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}\right)$
